facts.text: Serve the drinks when Goldfinger offers Bond a mint julep at his Kentucky stud farm.
facts.why: At Auric Stud, Kentucky, Goldfinger tells Bond to sit and asks 'Mint julep?', then later asks if the julep is tart enough.

facts.text: Dinner at Auric Enterprises is gold plated, Mr Bond. Oddjob will take your hat at the door.
facts.why: Not a film line. Goldfinger's real lines on the page opened include 'No Mr Bond, I expect you to die!'. The printed words are an invented quote.
facts.fix: No, Mr. Bond, I expect you to die!

fix_note.text: No, Mr. Bond, I expect you to die!

vibe.verdict: A hotel in-room layout that matches the Miami and Kentucky scenes, with Oddjob, Fort Knox and the champagne line used well.
